blurb: Official X account of Pope Leo XIV, head of the Catholic Church since May 2025. The account shares papal messages, teachings, and greetings, continuing the tradition of the @Pontifex handle. As of May 2025, the account is newly launched and growing.
credibility_note: Official Vatican account; content is authoritative for papal statements and Church doctrine.

sources.title: Pope Leo XIV on social media: Instagram and X accounts up and growing
